experiments.name: Phase 2 - Bigram Contextual Scorer
experiments.exit_gate_criterion: ≥5% relative error reduction on held-out test fixtures
experiments.conclusion: Bigram language model from dictionary data lacks discriminatory power for homophone disambiguation. Recommend proceeding to SLM-based reranker (Phase 3) or training on larger corpora.

experiments.name: Evaluator-based Candidate Request Export
experiments.description: Adds --slm-request-output CLI flag to the C++ contextual evaluator, generating JSONL request files with per-position candidate slots from the ReadingGrid baseline segmentation. The output schema is compatible with the Python SLM reranker experiment runner, enabling candidate-only output validation (candidate_validation.exercised=true). Includes a fix for build_scorer_request to pass baseline_output from fixture instead of empty string.
next_steps: Implement llama.cpp wrapper scorer for real model evaluation
Benchmark quantized 200M–0.5B models on the three fixture suites with candidate validation
Gate: any candidate SLM must beat deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures before Phase 3

experiments.name: Persistent External Scorer Protocol
experiments.description: Adds a persistent scorer protocol (--persistent-scorer-command) to the SLM reranker experiment runner. Keeps the scorer process alive for all fixture cases, communicating over stdin/stdout pipes. Eliminates per-case subprocess spawn overhead (~430x latency reduction at p95: 19ms to 45us). Mock scorer supports --persistent mode for protocol verification. select(2)-based timeout; Unix-only.
experiments.verification: Syntax check + self-test (includes persistent path) + dry-run + per-case mock + persistent mock + privacy check + git-diff-check
next_steps: Implement llama.cpp wrapper scorer with persistent protocol support
Benchmark quantized 200M–0.5B models on the three fixture suites using persistent protocol
Gate: any candidate SLM must beat deterministic reranker on held-out Taiwan fixtures before Phase 3

experiments.name: Local Tiny-LLM Scorer Wrapper Scaffold
experiments.description: Local tiny-LLM scorer wrapper scaffold with --provider command/ollama, --dry-run-baseline, and --model-manifest parameter enforcement. No real 200M–0.5B model was benchmarked; the 5 installed Ollama models are all 9B+.
next_steps: Benchmark a real 200M–0.5B model through --provider command with llama-cli or similar

experiments.name: SLM Reranker Benchmark Suite Runner
experiments.description: Bounded qwen2.5:0.5b Ollama HTTP smoke benchmark using character-granularity requests and candidate-index prompting on taiwan_ambiguous only. Index parsing removes non-candidate text violations, but qwen usually emits the wrong number of indices: 14/100 exact matches, 81 fallbacks, p95 latency 514115us.
next_steps: Do not expand candidate-index prompt-only qwen benchmarking unless the model can produce full-length index arrays reliably
Prefer non-generative candidate rankers or a true constrained decoder
Gate: SLM must beat deterministic reranker before Phase 3

experiments.name: Phase 2 Deterministic Context Rule Improvement
experiments.description: Normalizes protected-token spacing expectations, prevents partial-span corrections from overriding equivalent baseline spans, fixes punctuation spacing in the evaluator, adds narrow protected-English plus Taiwan-specific context rules, and closes the final Taiwan-specific data/literal-token gaps. Improves deterministic reranker from 203/234 to 234/234 exact matches while staying sub-millisecond at p95.
experiments.gate_result: PASS for deterministic regression lane; not an SLM gate
verification: deterministic evaluator on taiwan_ambiguous, english_mixed, taiwan_specific
next_steps: For 200M-0.5B tiny models, require candidate-constrained output plus latency gating before any synchronous IME path
Expand held-out/generalization fixtures because the current 234-case suite is saturated
Keep 234/234 deterministic-reranker as the current promotion baseline; tiny LLMs must match it here and win on new held-out cases or provide a clear latency/capability advantage

experiments.name: Heldout Generalization Fixture & Baseline
experiments.description: 63-case held-out generalization fixture with 6 categories (homophone 12, taiwan_specific 10, english_mixed 10, slang 10, punctuation_spacing 10, stress_test 11). Baseline evaluator scores 39/63 (61.9%); deterministic reranker scores 41/63 (65.1%) with p95 837us. The 234-case saturated suite is at 234/234 deterministic; this fixture provides held-out headroom (22 remaining errors) for tiny-LLM or improved reranker evaluation.
experiments.saturation_gate: The 234-case suite is saturated at 234/234 (deterministic). The heldout fixture provides the only remaining headroom for reranker improvement. Candidate rerankers must maintain 234/234 on the saturated suite AND beat deterministic 41/63 (65.1%) on heldout_generalization.

experiments.name: qwen2.5:0.5b Candidate-Index Heldout Benchmark
experiments.description: Real qwen2.5:0.5b Ollama HTTP benchmark on the new heldout_generalization fixture using character-granularity candidate requests and candidate-index prompting. The model scores 8/63 exact matches with 51 fallbacks from indices_length_mismatch, p95 latency 499869us, and 0 non-candidate violations on the 12 cases where candidate validation was exercised.
